http_semantics.note: The request-side-decidable error (undocumented verb) IS returned as a 4xx (404) — no 2xx masking involved. The claim targets the EMPTY BODY of that 404 (no diagnostic payload), not status-class masking. Same-family handler-level errors (cluster/recover 500, collections cluster op 400) return non-empty JSON diagnostic bodies, so the empty-body 404 is a disposition difference within the same route family.
